description.zh:
用户组名称。

您可以通过[ListGroups](~~28703~~)查看用户组名称。
description.en:
The name of the RAM user group.

If you want to query the name of a RAM user group, you can call the [ListGroups](~~28703~~) operation.

descriptions.zh: 删除用户组前，请确保用户组没有绑定任何权限策略且用户组内没有RAM用户。
descriptions.en: Before you delete a RAM user group, make sure that no policies are attached to the group and no RAM users are included in the group.
